1. What are cookies?
Cookies are small text files placed on your computer, tablet or mobile device when you visit a website.
They allow websites to recognise your device and remember certain information about your visit.
Cookies may be:
Session cookies
– deleted when you close your browser;
Persistent cookies
– remain on your device for a set period or until manually deleted;
First-party cookies
– set directly by HAVOC Watches;
Third-party cookies
– set by external services we use.
